name: mobile-world
description: Monorepo skeleton: Expo app + optional Next.js site + optional Supabase.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:rls && npm run check:secrets
scripts.db:up: bash infra/supabase/bootstrap.sh && docker compose -f infra/supabase/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/supabase/docker-compose.override.yml --project-directory infra/supabase/docker --env-file infra/supabase/.env up -d
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f infra/supabase/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/supabase/docker-compose.override.yml --project-directory infra/supabase/docker --env-file infra/supabase/.env down
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/supabase/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/supabase/docker-compose.override.yml --project-directory infra/supabase/docker --env-file infra/supabase/.env down -v && npm run db:up
